apps.subtitle: PlayStation 2 emulator for ARM64
apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

## What's new
- About: the app's license, and the licenses of the open-source code it ships
- Remote play: ask for Android 17's local network permission
- Remote play: ARMSX2's copyright line on its new files
- Remote play: the Vulkan buffer extensions both or neither, and a per-driver switch
- Remote play: the host lets each friend in
- Remote play: the host's main thread no longer waits on the stream
- Remote play: no permanent port forward, and a renewal keeps its own port
- Remote play: a bad pasted code or a peer that resets at once no longer crashes the app
- Remote play: hosting no longer needs Discord
- Remote play: WebRTC's license on the encoder taken from its HardwareVideoEncoder
- Remote play: the join and leave notices and the Wi-Fi QoS option in every language
- Remote play: the controller reaches everything on its screens
- Remote play: the host sees who joins and who leaves
- Remote play: host on OpenGL too
- Remote play: its strings in all 19 languages
- Remote play: stream the game to a friend, who plays as player 2
- Remote play: miniupnpc 2.3.2 for the router port
- GS/SW: read the palette copy's texels with the source format fixed at compile time
- GS/SW: copy paletted sprite draws into 16-bit frames straight from local memory
- GS/SW: build the texture snapshot after the rest of the scanline selector
- GS: drop the block-dirty bitmap the GPU copy of local memory used
- GS: skip the block walk of a write whose pages are all marked already
- GS/TC: decode paletted hash-cache misses on the GPU (gpu_texture_decode)
- GS/Vulkan: put the GPU texture decode's batching in a class a host test can drive
- GS: add the gpu_texture_decode setting and a -gpu-texture-decode runner flag
- GS/Vulkan: compute decode of paletted texture windows from a GPU copy of local memory
- GS/TC: keep up to 1600 hash-cache entries, under a memory limit
- GS/TC: key a raw hash-cache window by the hashes of its blocks
- GS: mark the 256-byte blocks a write touches, in two dirty bitmaps
- GS/TC: key a paletted hash-cache window by its raw blocks
- GameDB (mobile): Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance (PAL) keeps textures resident
- MTVU: a savestate load no longer reverts VU1 memory to its pre-load contents
- GameDB (mobile): Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance II keeps textures resident
- GameDB (mobile): Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance keeps textures resident
- GS/Vulkan: let the texture upload ring grow instead of waiting
- GS/TC: upload a hash-cache miss from the hash pass's expansion
- Android: the texture pack "+" imports .zip and .tar.zst files
- catalog tests: check that WaitFor lasts until its deadline, not how many polls fit in it
- Qt: a double click does not toggle full screen while the mouse works an arcade gun
- Arcade: a mouse click fires the light gun, and a menu under the pointer keeps it
- Arcade: mouse buttons work the light gun and the touch panel
- FullscreenUI: format the on-screen keyboard sources the way clang-format wants them
- Screenshot harness: textdialog and padkeys pages play controller, keyboard and mouse input into Big Picture
- FullscreenUI: the RetroAchievements login fields open the on-screen keyboard dialog
- FullscreenUI: Back in the texture pack search dialog no longer also closes the texture packs window
- FullscreenUI: Big Picture's text dialog has an on-screen keyboard a controller, touch screen or mouse can type on
- FullscreenUI: on-screen keyboard model with the key layouts, selection movement and text editing, and its tests
- EE: pin $a2 and $s1 instead of $k0 and $at
- EE: reload only the caller-saved pins after the event-test stub's C call
- EE: keep the lazy-dirty pins in registers across SYSCALL, ERET, EI and MTC0 Status
- EE event test: look for a pending INTC/DMAC cause before calling out
- EE event test: skip the VU sync calls when no VU has anything to do
- tests: pin what the EE event test does on quiet and near-quiet entries
- eerunner: whole-machine fingerprint for twin runs between JIT builds
- eerunner: fingerprint all of VU0 for twin runs between JIT builds
- COP2: the run-ahead sync stub bounces a parked VU0 itself
- Deps: use a native arm64 DXC on Windows arm64 (fixes 0xc000007b)

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20261011...25e7084fdefcf1e9069481a583c38c103b03e8f1
